༄༅/ /gur gyi mgon po'i khro bcu'i srung 'khor rdo rje'i brag rdzong ma bar chad kun sel bzhugs/ /na mo gu ru shrī ma hā kā la ya/sangs rgyas kun

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gur gyi mgon po'i khro bcu'i srung 'khor rdo rje'i brag rdzong ma bar chad kun sel bzhugs// na mo gu ru shrī ma hā kā la ya/ sangs rgyas kun dngos rje btsun bla ma mchog /kun dga'i mtshan can sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gang / /dpal ldan bkra shis la sogs rtsa brgyud kyi/ /bla ma rnams la bdag yid gus btud nas/ /bstan bsrung gtso bo nag po chen po yi/ /gdams pa zab mo snyan brgyud khyad par can/ /rdo rje'i brag rdzong srung 'khor zhal shes bcas/ /bar chad kun sel gzhan la brtse bas bri/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i srung 'khor bsgom par 'dod pas/ thog mar skyabs 'gro spyi dang mthun pa nyer gcig la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa song rjes/ bla ma rin po che dang dkon mchog rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gcig sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i srung 'khor bsgom par bgyi'o/ /tshar gsum/ rang skad cig gi dpal rdo rje nag po chen por gsal ba'i snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa dbu'i cha la bzhugs pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po la sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na maḥshrī ma hā kā la maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā bhyaḥ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhu paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapta pra tītstsha swāhā/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shu n+yā ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/

stong pa'i ngang las suṃ las rdo rje'i brag rdzong zur gsum pa stong gsum gyi tshad dang mnyam pa'i steng du/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum mthing nag kha khyer la rdo rje dang me ri 'bar bas bskor ba'i nang du paṃ las padma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ de lta bu'i srung 'khor gyi nang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar padma nyi ma'i steng du bhrūṃ mthing nag las/ gnam lcags las grub pa'i mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ rtse mo rno ba/ khog pa stong pa/ yangs zhing rgya che bar gyur/ oṃ badzra tsakra rakṣa hūm̐ bhrūṃ hūm̐/ lan gsum/ kha dog dmar nag go skabs med par 'khor ba'i dbus dang phyogs bcur padma nyi ma ro'i gdan re re'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa re re/ de rnams las 'od 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dbus su rang nyid dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag che zhing cher 'bar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs khar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis kyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gser gyi gaṇḍi bsnams pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/

rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang / lhab lhub kyi klubs pa/ mi'i thung gel ba'i 'dug stangs kyi ro'i steng na 'gying zhing bzhugs pa/ phyogs bcu'i mgon po thams cad sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas gnam lcags kyi gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag thugs khar 'dzin pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyis cod paṇa dang / lhab lhub kyis klubs pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyi bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i steng gi char rigs lnga'i khyung chen nam mkhar lding ba/ g.yas su bya nag gshog skor byed pa/ g.yon du khyi nag 'khang zhing zug pa/ rgyab tu ce spyang 'bros 'ded byed pa/ mdun du mi nag 'o dod 'bod pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'khor khro bo bcu la gaṇḍī mi dgos/ thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor gyi phyi rol du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i shing brgyad/ shing gi rtsa ba la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad/ shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong brgyad/ steng gi nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sprin brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i klu chen po brgyad/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ lha chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po bcu gnyis/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ gzhan yang chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang /

rnal 'byor ma dang / mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma dang / ro dang ro langs dang / 'dre dang srin po dang / sha za dang ce spyang gi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ drag po'i dur khrod shin tu 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba dang bcas par gyur/ nang gi lha rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i stod du padma nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu bar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gur gyi mgon po khro bo bcu gcig bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ arghaṃ༞ pā dyaṃ༞ puṣpaṃ༞ dhū paṃ༞ dī paṃ༞ gandhaṃ༞ nai wi dyaṃ༞ shapta pra tītstsha swāhā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ arghaṃ sogs kyis gong bzhin mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso 'khor thams cad la mi bskyod pa re res dbu brgyan/ de nas bsrung zlog bsad gsum gyi dmigs pa las/ thog mar bsrung ba 'di rgyun gyi nyams len sogs la gal che bas/ de la rang gi snying kha'i gri gug gi yu ba'i nang nyi ma'i steng na rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hūm̐ mthing nag gi rnam par bstod pa/ de'i klad kor gyi nang du rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma mi bskyod pa longs sku yum med zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa de nyid/ rang gi chos 'brel thob pa'i bla ma zhal bzhugs thams cad 'dus par bsam/ de'i pad gdan 'og tu bla ma rnams kyi mtshan yig dang po bsam pas sku dang gsung /

hūm̐ gi mdun du pha ma dang 'jig rten pa'i dpon po bsrung dgos yod na de dang / g.yas su bu dang chung ma/ g.yon du spun zla/ rgyab tu 'khor g.yog slob ma/ 'og tu nor rdzas khang zhing sogs yod par bsam/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu'i nang du rang gi ming yig dang po/ de'i g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab rnams su gong bzhin pha ma sogs kyi ming yig dang po spu shad kyi bris pa tsam bsgom pa ste lus ngag gnyis/ de nas rang nyid nag po chen por gsal ba'i thugs kha nas 'od 'phros/ bla ma dang bsrung bya rnams kyi thugs dang rnam shes rang rang gi mtshan dang ming yig dang po'i rnam par bkug nas/ hūm̐ gi nang gi mtshan dang ming yig dang po rnams la thim pas sku gsung thugs dang lus ngag yid gsum tshang / hūm̐ dang bsrung bya rnams kyi mthar yi ge bcu gnyis pa/ bdun pa/ rtsa sngags rnams kyis bskor bar bsam pa'i sngags phreng rnams dang / snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang dang bsrung bya rnams kyi lus kyi nang gang bas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad phyir bton/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad rdo rje sngon po nas 'bras tsam gyis gtams par bsam pa lus bsrung ba/ rang dang bsrung bya rnams kyi lce rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa de'i bar mtshams thams cad rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyi gtams par bsams pa ngag bsrung ba/ rang gi sems dang bla ma'i thugs/ bsrung bya rnams kyi sems dbyer med pa/ de kho na nyid rgya mtsho'i don dang ma bral ba'i ngang du bzhag pa sems bsrung ba'i mchog ste lus ngag yid gsum bsrung ba'o/ /yang snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'khor lo la phog pas 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor bas dgra bgegs phye mar btang bar bsam/ khro bo rnams bar snang du bzhugs pas mi 'khor ba'o/ /yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros phyi rigs 'jig rten skyong ba rnams la phog pas rang rang gi srog snying phul nas phrin las rang dbang med par bsgrub par bsam/

yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros khro bo bcu phyi rigs skyong ba srung 'khor dang bcas pa la phog pas/ de thams cad las/ las mkhan mtshon cha thogs pa dang / bskal pa 'jigs pa'i dus kyi me lta bu'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ stong gsum gyi khams thams cad khyab/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu/ sems can yongs dang / rnal 'byor pa la gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad mes bsregs/ mtshon chas btub/ sha khrag sprul pa'i las mkhan rnams kyi zos/ rnam shes chos dbyings su yal/ rang la byad kha rbod gtong / mnan gtad byas pa thams cad mes bsreg cing / rlung gis gtor bar yang yang bsams la/ yi ge bcu gnyis pa/ yi ge bdun pa/ shā sa na la di na me ke na mā ra ya bzhag pa'i pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐ ces pa rnams gtso bor rang gang mos dang / gzhan rnams kyang ci rigs su bzla/ bzlas pa sdud pa dang / phreng ba rdo rje thal mo'i bar du bcug ste phreng ba la kha rlangs 'phog par byas la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rdo rje chen po'i go 'phangs tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod cing phreng ba mgo thog tu bzhag de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa rgyal po yis/ /gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i/ /bsrung ba'i dam tshig sbyor ba yi/ /rnal 'byor lus ngag yid gsum bsrung / /oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ phyi rigs 'jig rten skyong ba rnams khro bo bcu la thim/ khro bo bcu rang la thim/ rang mgon po'i nga rgyal gyis srung 'khor yangs pa'i nang du spyod lam byed par bsams la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag

/gur gyi mgon po 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yis sa la 'god par shog /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams/ /gdul dka' 'dul phyir khro bo yi/ /shin tu gtum pa'i khro gzugs kyi/ /ma rungs pa rnams tshar gcod shog /ces brjod/ yang srung 'khor 'di kho nas nyin mtshan dus 'da' ba'i nyams len byed na/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor thams cad 'og tu bshad pa bzhin bya'o/ /yang drug cu pa sogs las sbyor byed pa dang / rang la byad kha'i ltas byung ba'i dus su/ bzlog pa dang bsad pa'i dmigs pa bsgom dgos pas de'i dmigs pa ni thun mong du 'byung bas/ de la bsgom tshul ni/ dgra de nṛ las mi'i 'gro ba'am/ bgegs ste tri las mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang / sems can la 'tshe ba/ khyad par rang la gnod pa che shos rang gi dgra nṛ las gang yin pa der gsal ba gan rkyal du byas pa'i snying khar lag pa bsnol ba ste lus dang / de'i steng lces brang khebs pa ngag dang / snying kha'i nang khrag gi thig le'i dbus su hūm̐ bsam pa yid ste lus ngag yid gsum tshang / de'i lce'i steng nas 'khor lo'i mar rtse zug pa/ rtsibs bar rnams su yaṃ las rlung raṃ las me'i steng du nṛ dang tri las dgra bgegs lus rid pa/ skra 'dzings pa/ kha nas khrag skyugs pa lus dang yan lag shu ba'i phreng bas bskor ba mgon skyabs dang bral ba/ gos med cing 'dar ba/ yi mug dang dka' thub kyi nyams can/ bu ga dgu nas khu khrag 'dzag pa spyi bo tshugs su 'dug pa ste/ spyi gtsug rlung me'i steng du reg pa/ rkang pa gnyis kyi rtse mo rtsibs bar du nyug ge yod par bsam/ 'og gi de rang la mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba gang yin yang rung ste/ lus kyi sgo nas rdzas ngan bsags pa/ mnan gtad byas pa sogs rang gi snying kha'i 'od kyis bkug nas lus la bstim/ ngag gi sgo nas ngan sngags bzlas pa/

dmod pa 'dor ba sogs ji snyed yod pa rnams bkug nas ngag gi ngo bo lce la bstim/ sems kyi dmigs pa ji snyed byas pa sogs thams cad bkug nas sems kyi ngo bo'i khrag gi thig le'i dbus kyi hūm̐ la bstim/ yang thugs kha nas 'od 'phros/ khro bo bcu dang phyi rigs skyong ba rnams la phog pas/ de thams cad kyi srog snying phul zhing srog snying rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pas rang gi thugs khar thim par bsam/ phyogs mtshams kyi khro bo rnams zhal phyir gzigs/ steng 'og gi khro bo rnams zhabs g.yas brkyang du bsgyur/ rang gi thugs kha dang / khro bo bcu phyi rigs skyong ba dang bcas pa las sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul gyi khro bo/ lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag med spros nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa/ 'jig rten phung du 'jug pa/ rnal 'byor pa la gnod par byed pa rnams sa phyogs gang na gnas pa de nas rang dbang med par bkug nas rtsibs bar sogs kyi byad ma rnams la bstim/ bsad pa gtso bor byed na 'khor lo g.yas su bzlog pa gtso bor byed na g.yon du drag tu 'khor rlung mes rtsibs bar gyi byad ma rnams rim gyis phul/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi rim pas dum bur nyal nyil du btub/ mes bsregs/ rlung gis gtor/ sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sha khrag lhag ma rnams pho nya las mkhan gyis zos/ lce'i steng nas btsugs pa'i 'khor lo'i rtses srog rtsa don snying rnams bcad/ rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su bsgral bar bsam pa ni gtso bor bsad pa'i dmigs pa'o/ /yang pha rol nas gzhan gyi nag po chen po 'khor bcas sogs bsrung ma rbad byung na/ rang gi nag po chen po 'khor bcas kyi rtsar byung bas/ rang gi nag po chen po 'khor bcas rnams bkrag mdangs dang gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas ma bzod par phyir log ste/ kho rang gi sgrub pa po dngos la tshig pa zos nas tshar bcad par bsam/

rang gi nag po chen po 'khor bcas rnams kyang 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor nas dgra bgegs gang yin pa'i sar song nas de tshar bcad par bsam/ yang yul gyi rgyal po'i gnod pa bzlog na/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs bar sogs su nri las rgyal po dang / blon po gros dbang gang yin gong bzhin bskyed la/ yang yang bstim zhing tshar bcad par bsam/ yang dmag zlog na'ang rtsibs bar sogs su dmag dpon/ dmag las gtso gang che rnams nri las bskyed pa/ bstim pa/ tshar bcas pa sogs gong bzhin dang / slar yang pho nya las mkhan sde brgyad kyi dmag dpung dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa phar 'phros/ dmag jag tshur 'ong ba rnams kyi lag cha phrogs/ mtshon chas bsnun te stobs gshed nyams par byas tshur khrid nas mdun du lcags kyi hom khung gru gsum pa gting zabs pa'i nang du bcug ste/ 'khor lo las ri rab zur drug pa dpag tu med pa 'phros nas mnan/ pho nya sde brgyad rnams kyis de'i steng du sgar brgyab nas bskal pa'i bar du mi thar bar bsams la shā sa na'i mjug tu dmag jag gi gnod pa dī na me ke na mā ra ya phaṭaḥstaṃ bha ya nanaḥbhyoḥbazlog ces pa ji ltar rigs pa bzlas shing dmigs pa gsal po byung na gnod pa rang zhi la 'gro nges so/ /bzlog pa'i dmigs pa 'di rnams byed dus 'khor lo g.yon du 'khor ba kho na'o/ /bzlog pa dang bsad pa'i dmigs pa byed dus/ dmigs gsal med pa rnams la shā sa na la pa tsa pa tsa'i rjes la dī na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces btags pa lnga brgya la sogs bzlas pa'i rjes la/ shā sa na'i i daṃ duṣṭaṃ ces pa'i mjug tu byad ma kha khaḥ byad ma khā hi khā hiḥ byad ma ma ra ma raḥ byad ma gṛhna gṛhnaḥ byad ma bandha bandhaḥ byad ma ha na ha naḥ byad ma da ha da haḥ byad ma pa tsa pa tsaḥ byad ma dī na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa la sogs pa dang / bhā ya na tshar gsum bzlas la/

thal mo sbyar nas su gang dag bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shugs gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / bsam pa dang sbyor ba ngan par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig gal te zhi bar ma gyur na de'i tshe/ de dag thams cad kyi lus bcing bar bgyi'o/ /ngag bcing bar bgyi'o/ /yid bcing bar bgyi'o/ /mthu brlag par gyur cig rdzu 'phrul brlag par gyur cig stobs brlag par gyur cig des bzlas pa'i sngags kyi de nyid brlag par gyur cig des bsgrub pa'i lha 'dre de nyid kyis de'i sha la za bar gyur cig ma hā kā la'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlog /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rgyal po yi/ /sogs man gong bzhin bya'o/ /bsad zlog gi dmigs pa gang byed na'ang bsrung ba'i dmigs pa rnams rdzogs rjes bsgom pa yin zhing / sngags thung gnyis ji ltar rigs pa'i rjes su/ shā sa na mā ra'i mtha' can dang spel tshig can gtso bor bzla'o/ /spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ spyod lam thams cad du phyi snod kyi 'jig rten srung ba'i 'khor lo dang / nang bcud kyi sems can mgon po bcu gcig sgra thams cad yi ge bdun pa/ bcu gnyis ma/ shā sa na sogs kyi sgra/ sems kyi cho 'phrul thams cad ye shes kyi rang bzhin du shes pa'i ngang nas 'khor lo'i nang du spyod lam byed par bsam pa'o/ /nyal ba gnyid kyi rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pa nas khro bo bcu rang la thim pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ rang nyid gdan dang bcas pa snying kha'i gri gug hūm̐ dang bcas pa la thim/ gri gug pad nyi dang bcas pa nyi gdan dang hūm̐ la thim/

nyi ma zhabs kyu la thim/ zhabs kyu khog pa la thim/ khog pa mgo bo la thim/ mgo bo zla tshes la thim/ zla tshe thig le la thim/ thig le nā da la thim/ nā da yang je phra je phrar song nas nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang du nyal bar bya'o/ /nang par ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ gnyid sad ma thag hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rang skad cig gis nag po chen por bsam/ yang hūm̐ zhes brjod pas khro bo bcu phyi rigs skyong ba rnams gsal lam byung bar bsam zhing / srung 'khor gyi nang du spyod lam byed par bsgom/ khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag gi sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyi rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas rang gi spyi bo nas bdud rtsi blugs par bsam zhing / ngag tu oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing gsung bar mos la bum chu'am chu gtsang gi khrus dngos su byas pas sdig sgrib dag par bsam/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni rang mgon por gsal ba'i snying kha dang / lte bar me 'bar ba'i khrod du snying khar gur gyi mgon po khro bo bcu gcig gi gtso bo'i dbu'i steng du bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam par bzhugs pa rnams bsam/ lte bar phyi rigs skyong ba thams cad bsams la/ kha zas rnams dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag tu mos la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ lag pa g.yas dgang gzar/ g.yon blug gzar du bsam/ kha thab khung me 'bar ba'i khrod du sha khrag bdud rtsir bsam pa'i kha zas thog mar gang za ba de lag pa g.yas pas g.yon par gtad/ g.yon pas khar phul bas/ snying kha dang lte ba na bzhugs pa rnams kyi thugs brgyud tshim zhing mnyes par bsams la longs spyod/

zas pa'i lhag ma la mchil mas btab ste/ oṃ u tstshiṣṭa ba ling ta bhakṣa si swāhā/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin no/ /zhes pa'i lhag ma btang / gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gtor ma byad ma'i sha khrag tu bsams la gtor chog bzhin phul/ thun gtor sgrub khang gi steng ngam/ dgra phyogs su bskyal nas lha bsrung thams cad kyi dmag drangs nas bsad bcad kyi las mdzad par bsam/ slar lha bsrung rnams rang la bsdu'o/ /rdzogs rim bsgom na nyal ba'i rnal 'byor bzhin rim bzhin bsdus la/ nā da mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang du mnyam par gzhag la/ rtog pa'i sbun lang na chu las nya 'phar gyi tshul du rang skad cig gis nag po chen por langs la/ rjes dge ba la bsngo bar bya ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i sgo nas srung 'khor 'di nyid thun bzhi la sogs par snying rje dang ldan zhing brtson 'grus chen pos bsgrubs na/ rab kyi nag po dngos su mthong / /'bring gis mi nag bya nag mthong / /sgra dang 'od dang a tsa ra/ /gtor ma me 'bar dngos su mthong / /tha ma nag po chen po dang / /bla ma dge bshes mi dpon dang / /gtso bo bud med rgyan ldan dang / /mi nag bya nag khyi nag dang / /hor sogs bandhe a tsa ra/ /rmi lam byung na nye ba'i rtags/ /gzhan yang dar 'phyar dung 'bud dang / /nyi zla 'char ba 'grub pa'i rtags/ /mkhar dang rdzong nang 'dug pa dang / /go mtshon thogs pa bsrung ba'i rtags/ /g.yag sogs srog chags bsad pa dang / /hor pas brdab chags 'ded pa dang / /ce spyang ri dwags gsod pa dang / /shing gcod brag bshig gsod pa'i rtags/ /ce spyang ma rung bsad pa dang / /bdag gi dmag dpon bskos pa ni/ /pha rol dmag dpung bzlog pa'i rtags/ /bla ma mi mnyes drag po dang / /dpon g.yog nang 'thab a tsa ra/ /bdag la khros pa bzlog pa'i rtags/ /de dus srung 'khor gnad du che/ /bud med ngu zhing rgyan cha ngan/ /lha cha skad med mtshon cha brtul/

/bya rog rod ngan mdze pho ni/ /nyam chags rtags yin bshags pa bya/ /zhes 'phags pas gsungs pa ltar gyi rtags rnams 'byung bas 'di rnams lan gsum re bskyar nas byung na nges pa'i rtags yin no/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po 'di nyid kyi srung 'khor rdo rje'i brag rdzong gi man ngag zab mo snying nang gi khrag lta bu 'di/ shin tu zab cing ches khyad par du 'phags pas/ dam tshig dang mi ldan pa sogs snod min rnams la gsang ba'i phyir dang / gsang sngags zab mo bla ma la ma brten par rang dgar spyad dogs/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gab 'khrugs su bzhugs pa snang mod kyang / deng sang snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus 'dir man ngag bla ma la zhus shing gtugs pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ ming tsam yang mi shes shing / cung zad re shes par rlom pa rnams kyang rang bzo ham pa su che'i nyams len ma gtogs phan yon yod pa ma mthong ba dang / man ngag zab mo nub dogs bla ma dang / bka' bsrung khyad par can rnams la mchod gtor phul zhing gsol ba btab nas/ bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa'i bsam pa kho na dang / rang dang nye bar gnas pa'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po grogs mchog dam pa rin chen rnam grol gyi gtso mdzad bshes gnyen dam pa du mas bskul zhing / rigs dang chos kyi bu la bsam nas shin tu gsang ba'i man ngag zab mo rdo rje'i brag rdzong ma'i nyams len rnams cung zad kyang ma sbas par/ dkar shākya grags kyi mdzad pa'i mgon po'i khro bcu srung 'khor dang / chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i nag po chen po'i bsrung bzlog bsad gsum sogs kyi man ngag tshigs bcad ma dam pa kun dga' grags la gnang ba/ bla chen bsod blos mdzad pa'i srung 'khor sogs kyi zhal shes zab bsdus kyi man ngag tshigs bcad ma/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i srung 'khor rdo rje'i brag rdzong rnams la brten zhing / gzhan yang bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gsung rgyun phyag len gyi brgyan ste/

dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje dang ldan pa rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub/ grub chen dpal ldan bkra shis/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa sogs yongs 'dzin bslu med dam pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len zhing rjes su bzung ba sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyi shing mo glang lo rgyal zla ba'i mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus khyad par can nyer dgu'i nyin mchod gtor rgyas pa dang bcas te/ lha khang chen mo'i yangs steng po tā la smon gnas yid 'ong tshal du sbyar ba'o/ /'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis pa rnams bla ma dang bsrung ma'i tshogs la bzod par gsol nas/ bstan 'gro la phan par gyur cig/ //'di bris dge ba gaṅgā'i chu rgyun gyis/ /rdo rje theg pa'i gdams pa zab mo yi/ /nyams len 'bad stsol bgyid pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /bar chad zhi zhing dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /maṅga la mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ gur mgon khro bcu'i srung 'khor sogs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
